{{Quote|Years back, the Morgukai took me prisoner in order to lure a worthy opponent--a Jedi. They killed her, then let me go. Now they're training other Nikto on Nar Shaddaa to hunt and kill Republic targets. Someone has to stop them at their temple and drive them offworld.|Tythan Phomm|<ref name="TOR:TM" />}}
'''Tythan Phomm''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] living during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. At one point, he was captured by [[Morgukai]] warriors and used as bait to lure in a [[Unidentified Jedi (Morgukai)|female]] [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]]. The [[Morgukai]] was a cult of [[The Force/Legends|Force]]-resistant [[Nikto/Legends|Nikto]] warriors who trained recruits to attack Republic targets. After defeating the Jedi, the [[Nikto/Legends|Nikto]] let Phomm go, and he would harbor a grudge agaist them for years to come. In [[3643 BBY]] Phomm resided on [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]] and discovered the Morgukai have set up the [[Morgukai temple]] in the area. He hired a Republic hero to attack the Morgukai, expecting them to fall in battle and satisfy the Morgukai bloodlust, but instead the hero surviced the ordeal and crippled their entire operation.
